question: In many countries, more and more people choose to buy imported food rather than food produced locally. Why do people buy imported food? What could be done to encourage people to buy local food?
essay:
Nowadays, it is common belief that consumers tend to purchase foreign food instead of locally grown food. This essay below will examine the reasons behind this practice and propose some measures to encourage people to choose local food. 

Imported food is gaining popularity due to several factors. Initially, foreign exotic food that offers a greater variety and perceived quality makes them more appealing to consumers than the ones in domestic areas. For instance, when it comes to snacks, people usually think about Chinese snacks such as cay cay stick or desert; apple or blueberries in the USA is also an ultimate option. Because these items bring people a sense of luxury and status that local available food may lack. Moreover, global supply chains and economies of scales have been promoted intensely allowing residents to access foreign produce both easily and affordably. 

However, despite the aforementioned benefits of introducing imported food in daily supplies market, it is inevitable that local produce is more and more high quality and organic compared to foreign goods. Therefore, the domestic companies should raise awareness about the importance of consuming locally grown food by highligting the health, economic and environmental advantages of them. Hence, this campaigns can foster a sense of pride in homegrown food. Secondly, the government may implement several policies such as community-support-agricultural program, tax incentives to assist farmer to reduce logistic and financial barriers. So citizens can easy to find fresh and good products closer to them, make these produce is competitively priced, encouraging the comprehensive development of the domestic economy. In conclusion, people usually choose imported food because of its good quality and accessibility, so companies and the government need to implement many strategies to promote the consuming of local produce.
